name: DJI ROMO
legalEntityNote: This profile covers DJI's ROMO cleaning-robot business. Regional DJI entities, ecommerce sellers and product-responsibility records may differ by market.
headline: DJI ROMO ownership, cleaning-robot platform, product strategy and support boundaries
description: A source-backed profile of DJI's ROMO robot-vacuum business, current platform, company boundary, product evidence, regional availability and buyer checks.
metaDescription: DJI ROMO brand profile: DJI relationship, ROMO robot vacuums, navigation, mopping, docks, channels, support and competitive strategy.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with DJI or ROMO. This page is scoped to DJI's cleaning-robot business; statements about ROMO products, regional support and model documentation must not be generalized to DJI's drone or camera businesses.
founded: ROMO launched as DJI's cleaning-robot brand in 2025; DJI was founded in 2006.

ownership.summary: ROMO is a DJI cleaning-robot brand and product business, not a separate public company. Official ROMO manuals, release notes and websites carry DJI branding and copyright notices. DJI is privately held and founded by Frank Wang; the official materials reviewed do not provide a current public shareholder table for the private group. Brand ownership does not by itself identify the factory, importer, seller or warranty provider for every ROMO market.

leadership.name: Frank Wang (Wang Tao)
leadership.context: DJI's corporate materials identify Frank Wang as founder and CEO. This parent-company role should not be presented as a separate ROMO legal-entity appointment.

productPortfolio.name: ROMO P series
productPortfolio.positioning: Transparent flagship robots and docks emphasizing multi-sensor perception, fine-object avoidance, strong airflow and automated hygiene functions.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Targets premium accounts where obstacle handling and design matter, but transparent housings, consumables, dock maintenance and local service need evaluation.

productPortfolio.name: ROMO A series
productPortfolio.positioning: A mixed transparent-and-white platform carrying much of the same cleaning architecture at a different design and price position.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Requires model-specific comparison because visible enclosure differences do not necessarily indicate a different core cleaning system.

productPortfolio.name: ROMO S series
productPortfolio.positioning: The white-bodied entry route into the ROMO platform.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Creates a lower price tier but still depends on app-region support, dock consumables and authorized service.

productPortfolio.name: App, accessories and consumables
productPortfolio.positioning: ROMO Home software, dust bags, brushes, mops, cleaning solution and maintenance parts complete the ownership system.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Long-term value depends on regional app access, consumable availability, firmware support and repair parts rather than robot specifications alone.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The official ROMO user manual, release notes and service materials identify the products and software as DJI ROMO and carry DJI copyright and support contacts.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Use the exact market manual, rating label and declaration to identify the responsible legal entity for the purchased model.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The reviewed public materials do not establish one physical assembly factory for every ROMO model, generation and destination market.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the factory, country of origin, exporter and batch traceability from product and shipment documents.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: DJI says ROMO's perception and path-planning development draws on experience from its wider robotics and drone technology base.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not convert a technology-origin statement into a claim that the same team, factory or service network handles every DJI product.

marketsChannels.evidence: ROMO's official website provides market and language selection, product pages, downloads, firmware notes and after-sales information.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm that the exact model, app, consumables and warranty service are officially supported in the destination market.

marketsChannels.evidence: Product availability, pricing, plumbing options and bundles differ across ROMO markets and generations.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Match the SKU, plug, water system, app region and included accessories to the purchase contract.

marketsChannels.evidence: Retailers and marketplaces may sell ROMO outside a buyer's normal regional support route.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify seller authorization, importer, serial-number eligibility, returns, parts and written warranty before cross-border purchase.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: ROMO gives DJI a credible entry into premium robot vacuums by transferring perception, path-planning and industrial-design strengths into a high-attention consumer product. Fine-object avoidance and transparent design differentiate the launch, but floorcare is a repeated-use service category: mopping, hair handling, dock hygiene, consumables, firmware and repair response will determine durable competitiveness more than DJI's brand halo alone.

developments.title: ROMO continues firmware development
developments.summary: Official release notes documented continued feature, language and stability updates across the ROMO platform.

developments.title: ROMO expands software and regional functions
developments.summary: The release notes added languages, network-region switching, voice control and cleaning-workflow changes.

developments.title: DJI launches the ROMO cleaning-robot platform
developments.summary: The initial A, S and P range brought DJI into robot vacuums with multi-sensor navigation, rotary mopping and automated docks.
